subject: Request: Increase trial credits for large-context POC (Novum AI)
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novum.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC scope — ask for larger trial credits (context window and TPM)

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. We’re excited to move this POC forward — our evaluation will stress large context windows (up to 150k tokens/session) and sustained throughput during batch ingestion at ~60 TPM. Given that usage profile, the default signup credits will be exhausted within a day.

Could Redwood temporarily increase the self-serve free credits for our account to support a 30-day POC? We’re asking for an initial one-time top-up of 250,000 free token credits (we can provide more detailed token estimates — attached).

Goals:
- Validate retrieval-augmented generation over long context (150k)
- Measure tail-latency and cost for production routing
- Run 3 end-to-end pipelines concurrently for up to 2 weeks each

We’re ready to sign a short mutual action plan and an NDA (DocuSign link included in attachments). If you need to route this for approval, please let us know who on your side we should expect to hear from.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of ML — Novum AI
alex.rivera@novum.ai

Attachments: novum-poc-scope.pdf, estimated-tokens-breakdown.xlsx
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novum.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC scope — ask for larger trial credits (context window and TPM)

Hi Alex —

Appreciate the clear scope and the attachments. This is exactly the kind of POC we like to support. I’ve looped in Marissa (our Enterprise AE) to coordinate the credit increase and any commercial terms. Quick questions to help us size the top-up:

- Is 150k tokens the max context length per user session, or a mix of session types?
- Do the 60 TPM refer to concurrent sessions, or aggregated calls distributed across your test harness?
- Any regulatory constraints (e.g., data residency) we should note for Private/Dedicated fallback?

Operational note: we can do a self-serve credit elevation that grants an initial one-time top-up to your account, subject to an approved usage cap and audit triggers. I’ll attach the token estimate you sent to the internal thread.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate with Marissa on approvals and get back shortly with a proposed amount and monitoring safeguards.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novum.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-19T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC scope — ask for larger trial credits (context window and TPM)

Thanks for the context, Alex & Rachel. I reviewed the scope and the token estimate. Recommendation: approve a one-time self-serve top-up of 200,000 free credits with the following conditions:

- 45-day POC window from issuance date.
- Usage cap set at 300k tokens daily; automated alert to AE/SE at 70% and 95% consumption.
- Require completion of the short security questionnaire before full uplift (partial uplift allowed).
- If we progress to a contract within the POC, credits applied as an onboarding credit (convertible).

Aditya — can you sign off on the $0 risk exposure for the first 200k credits with monitoring? If yes, I’ll push the self-serve uplift and notify Novum.

Alex — if that looks OK, please confirm you’re okay with the 45-day window and the monitoring alerts. We’ll share the console steps for self-serve top-up and a quick checklist to enable the long-context runtime.

– Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novum.ai>
Date: 2026-04-20T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC scope — ask for larger trial credits (context window and TPM)

Marissa — approved with conditions.

I’m comfortable approving the one-time 200,000 free-credit uplift for Novum AI provided we implement the monitoring and temporary caps you noted. Conditions:
1) 45-day POC period.
2) Automated alerting to SE/AE and weekly usage snapshot to finance.
3) Security questionnaire must be submitted within the first 10 days; if not received, we reduce daily cap to 100k tokens.

Finance note: treat this as a promotional credit (no immediate revenue impact) and tag under NOV-2026-1829. If they convert to a paid contract, credits will be reconciled per the MSA.

Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novum.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-22T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC scope — ask for larger trial credits (context window and TPM)

Hi Alex — good news: leadership approved an initial self-serve credit uplift of 200,000 free tokens for Novum AI under a 45-day POC. Conditions are below (copied from Aditya):

- 45-day POC window starting when credits are issued.
- Daily usage cap: 300k tokens; automated alerts at 70% / 95% to AE/SE.
- Security questionnaire due within 10 days; partial cap reduction if not received.
- Credits will be applied as promotional onboarding credits; if you sign a contract during POC, we’ll reconcile per the MSA.

Next steps for you to accept the uplift (self-serve):
1) Log into the Redwood Console and navigate to Settings → Promotions → Request Top-Up.
2) Select the Novum AI POC package ("Large-context POC — 200k promo") and confirm.
3) Provide the signed NDA (DocuSign link) or upload to the Drive folder linked below.

I’ve attached the token estimate you shared and the POC scope for our records. I’ll also send a calendar invite for a short kick-off (30 min) with our SE to configure long-context runtime flags.

If anything changes on your side (more concurrency or longer sessions), flag it early and we can reconsider a follow-up top-up.

Thanks — looking forward to seeing the results.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

Attachments: novum-poc-scope.pdf, estimated-tokens-breakdown.xlsx
